items.title: Repair Network Update Part 1 is here!
items.body: Repair Network Update Part 1 is out! This is part 1 of 2, part 2 coming soon it will finish off any QOL fixes from part 1 and add alot more. The Claims screen has been redesigned, and the whole look and feel is more organized. Repair types are now in tabs, including Collision with both minor and major crash repairs, created from scratch. Eight new crash profiles add more variety to the damage and parts you'll be fixing, with heavy accidents causing damage behind the panels too. Repair points helps you find and work the screws, bolts and welds on the part you're looking at, you'll find it in the repair section once you've started repairing a car from Repair Network. You can also order one part, a few parts or the whole cart. Added the Tripod Work Light to PPD Supply, and added the GarageLink Charging Stand to PPD Supply! Plus cleaner claim cards, more maintenance jobs, fixes for crash cars disappearing or arriving without damage, and other minor bug fixes and QOL improvements. SellMe down payments now show in loan history, and Sold signs can be printed once a sale is agreed. Thanks for the support! -PPD Mods.

items.title: GarageLink 0.9.5 - Financing and the UK update PART 1
items.body: Financing is here. Sell cars on payments and carry the loan yourself, or send buyers to three partner lenders. Buyers apply for credit, you pull their report, you decide their downpayment, terms and rates, plus more.. Work every deal on the new negotiation tab with cosigners, split down payments, extras, final offers and more to explore. Late payers go to Collections, from reminders to repo and auction. The DMV goes international too, play in the UK with UK plates, a GB licence, V5C log books, vehicle tax and the MOT. The UK Update is part 1, it is still recommended to play using USA and a state. Thanks for the support! -PPD mods

items.title: 0.9.4: Printing fixes and a more reliable tablet.
items.body: This update fixes Print Studio, Vehicle Studio and document printing on some setups, and Reissue papers works every time again. Paperwork that wouldn't open or print now does. We've also added protections so the tablet and its apps keep running smoothly across many different setups and alongside other mods, plus plenty of smaller bug fixes. Thanks for the support!

items.title: GarageLink 0.9.2 - Repair Network
items.body: Repair Network is here. Take insurance repair jobs built around the game's native jobs, inspect customer cars through your tablet, submit estimates for approval and complete the repairs. Arrange a courtesy car through RentMe or use a simulated partner rental. Finish each job with a final inspection, signed release and printable paperwork. Includes detailed claim files, customer reviews, expanded invoices and a Refresh Claims button to bring in new work. Every document printable. Thank you again for downloading! -PPD mods

items.title: GarageLink 0.9.1
items.body: Printed signs and papers now stick to your cars, and the DEALER plate sits on the rear bracket. SellMe has a full-size website you can preview on a computer or a phone, a new showroom home page, far more detailed sale papers, and buyers who don't repeat themselves.

items.title: GarageLink is live!
items.body: GarageLink is now available on Nexus Mods. Thanks for downloading and trying it!

items.title: Welcome to GarageLink
items.body: Your PPD Instruments tablet for the garage. Title and register your cars in the DMV, insure them with Fender & Bender, and rent them out on RentMe or sell them on SellMe. PPD Supply delivers printers, document folders and flood lights to your desk. Tap ? on any screen for a quick guide.
